title: Apple sells fewer iPhones — and makes more money than ever

beats.narration: Apple is selling fewer iPhones than its peak — and making more money than ever.
The reason isn't hardware. It's the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, and Apple TV.
Services now bring in over 26 billion dollars a quarter, at far higher margins than any device.
Those subscriptions keep paying every single month, long after you buy the phone.
That's why Apple keeps shifting its story from gadgets to recurring revenue.
The iPhone got Apple into your pocket. Services keep it there. Follow for more.
